CREATE USER Admin WITHOUT LOGIN;
CREATE USER Analyst WITHOUT LOGIN;
CREATE USER Business WITHOUT LOGIN; 

ALTER ROLE db_datareader ADD MEMBER Admin; 
ALTER ROLE db_datareader ADD MEMBER Analyst; 
ALTER ROLE db_datareader ADD MEMBER Business; 

GRANT UNMASK ON SCHEMA::fhir TO Admin; 
GRANT SELECT ON SCHEMA::fhir TO Analyst; 
GRANT SELECT ON SCHEMA::fhir TO Business; 

GRANT SELECT ON fhir.patientIdentifier (
    patient_id,
    birthDate,
    deceasedDateTime,
    gender,
    maritalStatus_text,
    maritalStatus_coding_code,
    maritalStatus_coding_display,
    maritalStatus_coding_system,
    multipleBirthBoolean,
    multipleBirthInteger,
    resourceType,
    text_div,
    text_status,
    identifier_system,
    identifier_type_coding_code,
    identifier_type_coding_display,
    identifier_type_coding_system,
 --   identifier_type_text,
 --   identifier_type_value,
    name_family,
    name_given,
    name_prefix,
    name_suffix,
    name_use,
    telecom_system,
    telecom_use,
    telecom_value,
    communication_language_text,
    communication_language_coding_code,
    communication_language_coding_display,
    communication_language_coding_system
) To Business;
  
  -- impersonate for testing:
EXECUTE AS User = 'Analyst';
select top 100 * from fhir.patientIdentifier;
REVERT;

select current_user as login_name

ALTER TABLE fhir.patientIdentifier
ALTER COLUMN identifier_value ADD MASKED WITH (FUNCTION = 'default()'); --DLs, MRNs, Passports
ALTER COLUMN identifier_value ADD MASKED WITH (FUNCTION = 'partial(3, "-xx-xxxx", 0)'); --SSNs

ALTER TABLE fhir.patientIdentifier   
ALTER COLUMN identifier_value DROP MASKED;
